entities.name: HIV-1 Env gp160
observations: 768-aa query matches reviewed HIV-1 group M subtype B Env gp160 references at 82.9% identity and 100% query coverage (query_protein).
Sequence-derived mass 86.51 kDa; theoretical pI 8.65; estimates exclude processing and modifications.
Pfam matches GP120 (PF00516; positions 33–519) and GP41 (PF00517; positions 538–724).

Homolog annotations describe furin cleavage into gp120 and gp41, trimeric Env spikes, CD4 plus CCR5/CXCR4 receptor use, and gp41-mediated membrane fusion; these are homology-supported, not direct experiments on this sequence.
Reference homolog topology: N-terminal signal peptide, large extracellular region, single-pass membrane anchor, and cytoplasmic tail; positions vary among homologs.
